description: Fourth scenario split, written blind on 7 September 2026 before any run against it. Purpose: one pre-registered run of the category-inventory planner input, the decision-impact admission rule, the real Memory Weave retrieval pipeline, and shadow judging on ordinary turns. Half of the explicit questions carry no possessive on purpose. New persona, people, systems, and facts; no overlap with the other splits. Pass: at most 1 of 20 ordinary injections, at least 9 of 10 explicit recall, at least 75% implicit recall, no placebo, misleading, or unrelated private admission.
